articles.title: Charter School Inks 56K-SF Lease in Retail Center Near Miami Suburb
articles.narrative: BridgePrep Academy, a charter school network, has signed a 56,000-square-foot lease at the California Club Shopping Center in Ives Estates, near Aventura, Florida. The space was previously occupied by another educational institution. The transaction highlights the significant demand for educational facilities in South Florida, particularly for private schools, which has intensified since the pandemic due to an influx of new companies and residents. Brokers noted the challenge of finding suitable properties for educational operators given specific coding and layout requirements, necessitating quick action on available spaces.

data_points.address: 750 Ives Dairy Road, Ives Estates, FL
data_points.notable_features: Open-air shopping center located west of Interstate 95.
data_points.project_notes: The space was previously leased by Waterways Preparatory Academy @ Kropp Annex until at least last year.

articles.market_intelligence: Demand for grade schools, particularly private ones, has significantly increased in South Florida since the pandemic, driven by new companies and their employees relocating to the region. Miami-Dade County faces a shortage of properties suitable for educational operators due to specific coding and layout requirements.

articles.title: Taco Bell’s Office Lease Largest in Orange County, Calif., in Five Years
articles.narrative: Taco Bell signed the largest office lease in Orange County, CA, in five years, securing 254,162 square feet at Irvine Company's Alton HQ. This significant transaction contributed to an improved office market in the third quarter, with overall vacancy decreasing and average asking rents rising. The move reflects a trend of diverse corporate leasing activity in the region, despite a slight dip in net absorption for the quarter.

data_points.project_notes: Taco Bell plans to relocate from its current Irvine headquarters in 2028.

articles.market_intelligence: Orange County's office vacancy improved to 15.4% in Q3, down from 17.1% a year ago. Average asking rents increased to $3.02 per square foot per month, up from $2.90 at the end of 2025. Net absorption for the year remained positive at 265,394 square feet. Approximately 1.55 million square feet of leases were signed during the quarter. No new office completions have been recorded this year, with only one project, a 168,137-square-foot building at the Anaheim Ducks' mixed-use development, currently under construction and 23% pre-leased.

articles.title: Yves Saint Laurent to Open Store at Kering’s 717 Fifth Avenue
articles.narrative: Luxury fashion house Yves Saint Laurent will open a new 9,600-square-foot store at 717 Fifth Avenue in New York City. The space is located in the base of the former Corning Glass Building, which is owned by Kering and private equity firm Ardian. This move follows Kering's acquisition of the lower four floors of the building in January 2024 and a subsequent sale of a majority stake to Ardian, with the expectation that Kering would consolidate its brands within the property.

data_points.address: 717 Fifth Avenue, New York City, NY
data_points.notable_features: Located in the base of the former Corning Glass Building, across East 56th Street from Trump Tower.
data_points.project_notes: Kering acquired the lower four floors of the building in January 2024 for $963 million. Kering later sold a 60% stake to Ardian in December 2025, revaluing the commercial condominium to $900 million.

articles.title: Northern Virginia Office Vacancy Falls Again as AI, Defense Demand Builds
articles.narrative: Northern Virginia's office market experienced a sixth consecutive quarter of declining vacancy rates in Q3 2026, reaching 21.7%, driven by strong demand from artificial intelligence, technology, and defense sectors. The market recorded 672,378 square feet of positive net absorption, largely due to a significant relocation by a government agency. Despite a slowdown in overall leasing activity, new leases and relocations are dominating the market, indicating a shift from the previous renewal-focused era. This tightening supply is beginning to bolster rents, particularly for Class A properties, while new construction remains minimal and redevelopment proposals are high.
articles.market_intelligence: Northern Virginia's office vacancy rate has fallen for six consecutive quarters to 21.7%. Total available space is at its lowest level in a decade at 33.6 million square feet, a 25.5% decrease from the 2023 peak of 45.1 million square feet. Class A direct asking rents reached $42.51/SF/year, while overall direct asking rents averaged $38.13. Asking rents for Trophy, Class A, and Class B properties have risen since 2022, while Class C rents have declined. Only 34,000 square feet of new office construction is underway, with over 10 million square feet proposed for redevelopment.

articles.title: S3 Capital Supplies $20M for Boutique Miami Beach Condo
articles.narrative: Trinity Southern has secured a $19.5 million construction loan from S3 Capital for its boutique condominium development, Twenty Nine Indian Creek, in Miami Beach. The developer also closed on the $8 million acquisition of the 15,000-square-foot waterfront development site from JMH Development and has broken ground on the project. The eight-story building will feature 16 units, with 10 units already pre-sold, indicating strong market demand for luxury condos in the area.

data_points.address: 2901 Indian Creek Drive, Miami Beach, FL
data_points.notable_features: Eight-story boutique condo development located on the waterfront in the Mid-Beach neighborhood, near the Miami Beach Edition hotel.
data_points.project_notes: The 15,000-square-foot site was previously acquired for $8 million from JMH Development, which had initially proposed the condo development. 10 units have already sold.

articles.market_intelligence: Luxury condo developments in Miami Beach and South Florida continue to attract lenders. A Terra-led partnership recently secured a $507 million construction loan for a South Beach condo tower from Tyko Capital, notably before sales had launched. Last year, Mast Capital and Starwood Capital Group obtained $390 million in construction debt for an OMA-designed project in Mid-Beach.

articles.title: JLL Arranges Loan for Refinancing of 300-Unit Apartment Community in Northwest Dallas
articles.narrative: JLL has arranged refinancing for Standard at Royal Lane, a 300-unit apartment community in northwest Dallas. The newly constructed property, developed by LDG Development, features a mix of one- to four-bedroom units, some with income restrictions. The loan was provided by TPG Real Estate Credit.

data_points.notable_features: Amenities include two pools, dual fitness centers, a business center, and a theater room. Some units are subject to income restrictions.

articles.title: Marcus & Millichap Brokers Sale of 51,542 SF Retail Property in Richardson, Texas
articles.narrative: Marcus & Millichap has brokered the sale of Baybury Square Shopping Center, a 51,542-square-foot retail property in Richardson, Texas. The 11-acre property, comprising two multi-tenant centers and two freestanding buildings constructed in 1966, was 64 percent leased at the time of sale. The transaction involved an out-of-state investor as the seller and a local developer as the buyer, both of whom requested anonymity.

data_points.address: 940 E Belt Line Rd, Richardson, TX

articles.title: STRIVE Negotiates Sale of 16,599 SF Shopping Center in Granbury, Texas
articles.narrative: STRIVE has brokered the sale of Fountain Oaks Shopping Center, a 16,599-square-foot retail property in Granbury, Texas. The center, built in 2013, was 96 percent leased at the time of sale with a strong tenant mix. The seller was undisclosed, as were the buyer and the sales price.

articles.title: Alera Group Signs 13,668 SF Office at Lease in Northwest San Antonio
articles.narrative: Alera Group, an insurance and financial services company, has signed a 13,668-square-foot office lease in northwest San Antonio. The company will occupy space on the 10th floor of Concord Plaza, a mixed-use development featuring an 11-story office tower, a three-story corporate building, and ground-level retail.

data_points.address: 7850 Jones Maltsberger Rd, San Antonio, TX

articles.title: Equus Capital Partners Acquires 300,075 SF Industrial Development in Shrewsbury, Massachusetts
articles.narrative: Equus Capital Partners has acquired Centech Park North, a newly constructed 300,075-square-foot industrial development in Shrewsbury, Massachusetts. Developed by NorthBridge Partners and completed in 2023, the two-building park was fully leased at the time of sale to a diverse mix of tenants in life sciences, advanced manufacturing, and commercial services.

data_points.notable_features: Features 36-foot clear heights, 64 dock-high doors, and four drive-in doors.

articles.title: Ambrose breaks ground on second phase of logistics park in Whitestown
articles.narrative: Ambrose has broken ground on Buildings V and VI, the second phase of its Indianapolis Logistics Park – Northwest in Whitestown, IN. The speculative development will add approximately 947,000 square feet of industrial space to the fully occupied park, with completion targeted for summer 2027. The project is being financed with a construction loan from Fifth Third Bank.

data_points.property_name: Indianapolis Logistics Park – Northwest, Buildings V and VI
data_points.notable_features: Building V will offer 182,000 SF with 32-foot clear height; Building VI will offer 765,000 SF with 40-foot clear height. Both buildings are targeting LEED Silver certification and are located within an eight-minute drive from I-465 via I-865.
data_points.project_notes: This construction marks Phase II of the park's master-planned development. The park's existing buildings are fully occupied.

articles.title: Flexday Opens Flexible Office Space in Chicago’s Loop
articles.narrative: Flexday, a national provider of flexible office solutions, has launched four fractional office suites totaling over 25,000 square feet at PNC Centre in Chicago's Loop. This initiative, a partnership with building owner MetLife Investment Management, offers companies flexible, on-demand office space for teams of 10 to 70, providing a Class A environment without a long-term lease commitment. The launch is part of a broader capital investment by MetLife Investment Management in PNC Centre, which includes a newly renovated lobby and upgraded tenant amenities.

data_points.notable_features: Class A office environment with newly renovated lobby and upgraded tenant amenities.

articles.title: Colliers Represents ClarkDietrich in Anchor Lease at Ohio Office Development
articles.narrative: Colliers represented ClarkDietrich in a 32,558-square-foot office lease, securing nearly three-quarters of a new office building at Montgomery Quarter, a mixed-use development in Cincinnati, Ohio. This transaction highlights the continued demand for well-located, high-quality office space in the Cincinnati market, attracting tenants making long-term commitments. The new office provides access to retail and dining amenities, structured parking, and a modern workplace designed for collaboration.

data_points.notable_features: Located along the Montgomery Road corridor in Cincinnati’s northeastern suburbs, offering access to retail and dining amenities, structured parking, and a modern workplace environment.

articles.title: Apartment Property in Downtown Wenatchee Changes Hands
articles.narrative: A 23-unit apartment community in Wenatchee, Washington, known as Tamarack, has been sold for $3.25 million. The garden-style property, located near downtown, offers a value-add opportunity for the new owner. The transaction closed quickly, going under contract just three days after being listed, reflecting strong demand for multifamily assets in the area.

data_points.notable_features: Garden-style community located steps from downtown Wenatchee, offering value-add potential.
data_points.project_notes: First change of ownership in 19 years.

articles.title: Alterra IOS Expands Baltimore-Area Footprint with Acquisition
articles.narrative: Alterra IOS has expanded its Baltimore-area portfolio with the acquisition of a fully leased industrial property in Rosedale, Maryland. This transaction marks Alterra's seventh acquisition in the Baltimore metropolitan area, underscoring the firm's continued investment in a market characterized by strong demand and tight supply for industrial outdoor storage (IOS) properties.

data_points.notable_features: Located in close proximity to I-95 and I-695, along a key freight corridor connecting Baltimore with Philadelphia and New York.
data_points.project_notes: This is Alterra's seventh acquisition in the Baltimore MSA.

articles.market_intelligence: The Baltimore market for industrial outdoor storage (IOS) properties has a vacancy rate of approximately 2.5%, driven by strong demand from logistics and transportation users and its strategic proximity to the Port of Baltimore.

articles.title: Merchants Capital Secures $98M for VA Affordable Development
articles.narrative: Merchants Capital has secured $97.8 million in financing for the extensive rehabilitation of Stuart Gardens, a 491-unit affordable multifamily property in Newport News, Virginia. The financing package includes $62.8 million in HUD 221(d)(4) permanent financing and a $35 million equity bridge loan from Merchants Bank. Developed by Vitus Group, the project will preserve affordable housing for families earning 60% of the area median income and incorporate green and resilient retrofits.

data_points.notable_features: Designated as a historic property by the Virginia Board of Historic Resources; located within 1.5 miles of schools, public transportation, and essential services.
data_points.project_notes: Financing includes HUD 221(d)(4) permanent financing, low-income housing tax credits, and green and resilient retrofit program financing. 489 of 491 units are restricted to families earning 60% area median income.

articles.title: Law Firms Drive Boston Office Rents To Record Highs
articles.narrative: Trophy office rents in Boston have reached unprecedented levels, primarily fueled by robust demand from law firms. This surge is exacerbated by a significant shortage of new office construction in the market, limiting supply and pushing prices upward.
articles.market_intelligence: Law firms are a primary driver of demand for trophy office space in Boston. A lack of new construction is contributing to rising office rents.

articles.title: Coworking Space With Golf Simulators Opens In Cherry Creek: The Denver Deal Sheet
articles.narrative: A new coworking space, distinguished by its golf-centric amenities, has opened its second location in Cherry Creek. This expansion reflects a growing trend of specialized coworking environments catering to niche interests and professional networking.

data_points.notable_features: Features golf simulators as a key amenity.
data_points.project_notes: This is the second location for the coworking space.

articles.title: 3 Houston Office Properties, Vacant To Nearly Full, Change Hands
articles.narrative: JLL's report indicates a significant increase in sales within the Houston office market, with 105 office properties changing hands since January 2023, reflecting renewed investor interest.

articles.title: Industrious Takes Top Floors In Downtown Lease: The D.C. Deal Sheet
articles.narrative: Onward Investors has acquired an office property in Tysons from Nuveen. This transaction was part of a week that also saw Industrious secure the top floors of a downtown building in a new lease agreement.

articles.title: How U.S. Giant Realty Income Bought The UK And Europe
articles.narrative: Realty Income is strategically expanding its portfolio into UK and Irish retail parks, aiming to drive growth through targeted acquisitions. This move signifies a broader trend of U.S. real estate giants seeking opportunities in European markets, leveraging their capital and expertise to capitalize on different market dynamics and yield profiles. The expansion is expected to enhance Realty Income's diversification and long-term revenue streams.
